project.title: Video Site
project.goal: Conners Clinic's self-hosted video platform (PlayTube-based PHP) at videos.connersclinic.com: video library and watch pages, an admin panel, Whisper transcription with About and Transcript tabs, and an SEO content pipeline that turns transcripts into articles.

context.why: how transcripts become SEO articles (setup, cron, settings)
batch Whisper transcription and the watch-page tabs
public-repository rule, deploy branches and the Continuity section

notes: Public repository (owner's decision 2026-10-30 to keep Continuity notes here): write nothing private in .continuity/.
Deploys: pushing main updates the test site, pushing super the live site (.github/workflows/deploy.yml); pushes that change only Continuity files are skipped.
A Conners Clinic developer is working on PHP 8.2 compatibility (branches php82-staging-20261030 and php82-prod-20261030, 2026-10-30).
